title: React only touches DOM nodes that changed

slides.say: After rendering, React commits. But it does not rebuild the page.
This clock re-renders every second with a new time. Type into the input, and your text stays.

slides.text: React updates only the <h1> text. The <input> is in the same place, so React leaves it — and its value — alone.
slides.say: React only updates the h1’s text. The input appears in the same place as last time, so React does not touch it, or its value.

slides.text: Initial render: appendChild all nodes. Re-render: minimal operations.
slides.say: On the first render, React appends all the nodes it created. On re-renders, it applies only the minimal operations needed.
